# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Fig. 6a: Changes between the abundant and rare taxa in Baiau Superior ##
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------ The whole species inventory ------------------

# How many species persist, appear and disappear after the threshold?

```{r}

# ---------- Settings -----------

ecotone_sample <- 83
rel_threshold <- 2   # Only used later to distinguish abundant vs rare taxa

species_period_presence <- ba_rel %>%
  inner_join(period_samples, by = "sample") %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, period) %>%
  summarise(
    total_abundance = sum(No, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rel_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_occurrences = n_distinct(sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(present = total_abundance > 0) %>%
  select(Species_ID, period, present, total_abundance, mean_rel_abundance, n_occurrences)

# Define periods using the whole record:
period_samples_full <- ba_rel %>%
  distinct(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      sample <= ecotone_sample ~ "post",
      sample > ecotone_sample  ~ "pre"
    )
  )

# Classify all species:
species_turnover_status_full <- ba_rel %>%
  inner_join(period_samples_full, by = "sample") %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, period) %>%
  summarise(
    total_valves = sum(No, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_occurrences = n_distinct(sample),
    mean_rel_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rel_abundance = max(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    present = total_valves > 0
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    period,
    present,
    total_valves,
    n_occurrences,
    mean_rel_abundance,
    max_rel_abundance
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    values_from = c(
      present,
      total_valves,
      n_occurrences,
      mean_rel_abundance,
      max_rel_abundance
    ),
    values_fill = list(
      present = FALSE,
      total_valves = 0,
      n_occurrences = 0,
      mean_rel_abundance = 0,
      max_rel_abundance = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      present_pre  == TRUE  & present_post == TRUE  ~ "Persisted",
      present_pre  == TRUE  & present_post == FALSE ~ "Disappeared",
      present_pre  == FALSE & present_post == TRUE  ~ "Novel"
    ),
    
    max_rel_abundance_overall = pmax(
      max_rel_abundance_pre,
      max_rel_abundance_post,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    abundance_class = if_else(
      max_rel_abundance_overall >= rel_threshold,
      "Reached ≥2% at least once",
      "Always <2%"
    )
  )

# Summarise everything:
species_turnover_summary_full <- species_turnover_status_full %>%
  count(status, name = "n_species") %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_of_total = n_species / sum(n_species)
  )

species_turnover_summary_full

```

# ------------------ Abundant species (>=2% rel. abundance) ------------------

# Data treatment

```{r}

# ------------------- Starting data frame ----------------------------

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Raw_unified_data_frames/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# ------------------- User settings ----------------------------

ecotone_sample <- 83   # Sample threshold (mean age = 2327 cal yr BP)
rel_threshold <- 2     # Species kept if they reach >= 2% in at least one sample
pseudocount <- 0.02    # Avoids division by zero in ratios
ln10 <- log(10)

# ------------------- Relative abundances & Filtering ----------------------------

# Species data frame:
ba.spp.df <- subset(ba_sup_raw_df, select = c(1, 3:4)) 

# Relative abundances:
ba_rel <- ba.spp.df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sample),
    !is.na(Species_ID),
    !is.na(No),
    No > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample, Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    No = sum(No, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(any_of(c("mean.age", "top.age", "bottom.age", "age.interval")), first),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abundance = 100 * No / sum(No, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# How many species identified in total?
total_species <- n_distinct(ba_rel$Species_ID)
total_species 

# Keep only species reaching >= 2% once (abundant):
abundant_species <- ba_rel %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    max_rel_abundance = max(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(max_rel_abundance >= rel_threshold) %>%
  pull(Species_ID)

length(abundant_species)

# Complete the sample x species matrix with zeros (absences as zeros): avoids inflating relative abundances!
all_samples <- sort(unique(ba_rel$sample))

ba_abundant_complete <- ba_rel %>%
  filter(Species_ID %in% abundant_species) %>%
  select(sample, Species_ID, rel_abundance) %>%
  complete(
    sample = all_samples,
    Species_ID = abundant_species,
    fill = list(rel_abundance = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, Species_ID)

# ------------------- Define balanced pre- and post-ecotone periods ----------------------------

# This way we avoid comparing two different periods!

post_samples_all <- all_samples[all_samples <= ecotone_sample]
pre_samples_all  <- all_samples[all_samples > ecotone_sample]

n_post_all <- length(post_samples_all)
n_pre_all  <- length(pre_samples_all)

n_balanced <- min(n_post_all, n_pre_all)

# Use the samples closest to the threshold on both sides
post_samples <- post_samples_all %>%
  sort() %>%
  tail(n_balanced)

pre_samples <- pre_samples_all %>%
  sort() %>%
  head(n_balanced)

period_samples <- tibble(
  sample = c(pre_samples, post_samples),
  period = c(
    rep("pre",  length(pre_samples)),
    rep("post", length(post_samples))
  )
)

cat(
  "Ecotone sample:", ecotone_sample, "\n",
  "All post-threshold samples:", n_post_all, "\n",
  "All pre-threshold samples:", n_pre_all, "\n",
  "Balanced samples per period:", n_balanced, "\n",
  "Post samples used:", min(post_samples), "-", max(post_samples), "\n",
  "Pre samples used:", min(pre_samples), "-", max(pre_samples), "\n"
)

# Summarise mean relative abundance per species and period:
ba_period <- ba_abundant_complete %>%
  inner_join(period_samples, by = "sample") %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rel_abundance = mean(rel_abundance),      # Mean across all selected samples, including zero values when the species was absent
    sd_rel_abundance   = sd(rel_abundance),
    n_samples          = n(),
    se_rel_abundance   = sd_rel_abundance / sqrt(n_samples),
    n_occurrences      = sum(rel_abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compute post/pre log-ratios:
ba_ratio <- ba_period %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    values_from = c(
      mean_rel_abundance,
      sd_rel_abundance,
      se_rel_abundance,
      n_samples,
      n_occurrences
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{period}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pre_pc  = mean_rel_abundance_pre  + pseudocount,
    mean_post_pc = mean_rel_abundance_post + pseudocount,
    
    ratio = mean_post_pc / mean_pre_pc,
    log_ratio = log10(ratio),
    
    se_log_ratio = sqrt(
      (se_rel_abundance_post / (mean_post_pc * ln10))^2 +
        (se_rel_abundance_pre / (mean_pre_pc * ln10))^2
    ),
    
    status = case_when(
      mean_rel_abundance_pre == 0  & mean_rel_abundance_post > 0 ~ "New",
      mean_rel_abundance_pre > 0   & mean_rel_abundance_post == 0 ~ "Declining",
      TRUE ~ "Shared"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(log_ratio) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = factor(Species_ID, levels = Species_ID)
  )

```

# Plot 

```{r}

# Plot showing abundant species:
ba_ecotone_ratios_labelled <- ggplot(
  ba_ratio,
  aes(
    x = log_ratio,
    y = reorder(Species_ID, log_ratio),
    color = status,
    shape = status
  )
) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = log_ratio - se_log_ratio,
      xmax = log_ratio + se_log_ratio
    ),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      New = "blue",
      Declining = "red",
      Shared = "black"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      New = 1,
      Declining = 1,
      Shared = 16
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, face = "italic")    
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log10 ratio (post/pre)",
    y = "Diatom species",
    color = "Status",
    shape = "Status"
  )

ba_ecotone_ratios_labelled


```

# Data treatment

```{r, Data preparation for plotting}

# ------------------- Starting data frame ----------------------------

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Raw_unified_data_frames/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# ------------------- User settings ----------------------------

ecotone_sample <- 83   # Sample threshold (mean age = 2327 cal yr BP)
rel_threshold <- 2     
pseudocount <- 0.02    # Avoids division by zero in ratios
ln10 <- log(10)

# ------------------- Relative abundances & Filtering ----------------------------

# Species data frame:
ba.spp.df <- subset(ba_sup_raw_df, select = c(1, 3:4)) 

# Relative abundances:
ba_rel <- ba.spp.df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sample),
    !is.na(Species_ID),
    !is.na(No),
    No > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample, Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    No = sum(No, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(any_of(c("mean.age", "top.age", "bottom.age", "age.interval")), first),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abundance = 100 * No / sum(No, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# How many species identified in total?
total_species <- n_distinct(ba_rel$Species_ID)
total_species   # Result = 275!

# Keep only species reaching >= 2% once (abundant):
rare_species <- ba_rel %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    max_rel_abundance = max(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(max_rel_abundance < rel_threshold) %>%
  pull(Species_ID)

length(rare_species)

# Complete rare species x selected samples with zeros:
ba_rare_complete <- ba_rel %>%
  filter(
    Species_ID %in% rare_species,
    sample %in% period_samples$sample
  ) %>%
  select(sample, Species_ID, rel_abundance) %>%
  complete(
    sample = period_samples$sample,
    Species_ID = rare_species,
    fill = list(rel_abundance = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(period_samples, by = "sample") %>%
  arrange(sample, Species_ID)

# ------------------- Define balanced pre- and post-ecotone periods ----------------------------

all_samples <- sort(unique(ba_rel$sample))

post_samples_all <- all_samples[all_samples <= ecotone_sample]
pre_samples_all  <- all_samples[all_samples > ecotone_sample]

n_post_all <- length(post_samples_all)
n_pre_all  <- length(pre_samples_all)

n_balanced <- min(n_post_all, n_pre_all)

# Samples closest to the threshold on both sides
post_samples <- post_samples_all %>%
  sort() %>%
  tail(n_balanced)

pre_samples <- pre_samples_all %>%
  sort() %>%
  head(n_balanced)

period_samples <- tibble(
  sample = c(pre_samples, post_samples),
  period = c(
    rep("pre",  length(pre_samples)),
    rep("post", length(post_samples))
  )
)

cat(
  "Ecotone sample:", ecotone_sample, "\n",
  "Available post-threshold samples:", n_post_all, "\n",
  "Available pre-threshold samples:", n_pre_all, "\n",
  "Samples used per period:", n_balanced, "\n",
  "Post samples used:", min(post_samples), "-", max(post_samples), "\n",
  "Pre samples used:", min(pre_samples), "-", max(pre_samples), "\n"
)

# Summarise mean relative abundance per species and period:
ba_rare_period <- ba_rare_complete %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean.rel.abundance = mean(rel_abundance),
    sd.rel.abundance   = sd(rel_abundance),
    n                  = n(),
    se.rel.abundance   = sd.rel.abundance / sqrt(n),
    n_occurrences      = sum(rel_abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compute post/pre log-ratios:
ba_rare_ratio <- ba_rare_period %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    values_from = c(
      mean.rel.abundance,
      sd.rel.abundance,
      se.rel.abundance,
      n,
      n_occurrences
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{period}",
    values_fill = list(
      mean.rel.abundance = 0,
      sd.rel.abundance = 0,
      se.rel.abundance = 0,
      n_occurrences = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  # Remove species absent from both selected comparison windows: avoids producing an artificial log-ratio of zero!
  filter(n_occurrences_pre + n_occurrences_post > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    mean.pre.pc  = mean.rel.abundance_pre  + pseudocount,
    mean.post.pc = mean.rel.abundance_post + pseudocount,
    
    ratio = mean.post.pc / mean.pre.pc,
    log.ratio = log10(ratio),
    
    se.log.ratio = sqrt(
      (se.rel.abundance_post / (mean.post.pc * ln10))^2 +
        (se.rel.abundance_pre / (mean.pre.pc * ln10))^2
    ),
    
    status = case_when(
      mean.rel.abundance_pre == 0  & mean.rel.abundance_post > 0 ~ "New",
      mean.rel.abundance_pre > 0   & mean.rel.abundance_post == 0 ~ "Declining",
      TRUE ~ "Shared"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(log.ratio) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = factor(Species_ID, levels = Species_ID)
  )
```

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Fig. 6b: Temporal changes in the distribution of relative abundances ##
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -------- Baiau Superior ---------

# Quantile regression calculation

```{r, Define quantiles, fit the models, check the models}

# Raw data frame for Baiau Superior:
ba_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Raw_unified_data_frames/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# Compute relative abundances & modify the data frame:
ba_relative_abundances <- ba_raw_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    location,
    sample,
    mean.age,
    Species_ID,
    No
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(         # Compute relative abundances within each sample
    location, 
    sample,
    mean.age
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_count = sum(No, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_abundance = 100 * No / total_count
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

# -------- Smooth quantile regression --------

ba_qr_data <- ba_relative_abundances %>%
  mutate(
    age_kyr = mean.age / 1000
  )

# Define quantiles:
ba_quantile_def <- tibble(
  qu = c(0.60, 0.80, 0.95, 0.99),
  quantile_label = factor(
    c("0.60", "0.80", "0.95", "0.99"),
    levels = c("0.60", "0.80", "0.95", "0.99")
  )
)

# Fit one smooth model for each quantile:
ba_quantile_models <- ba_quantile_def %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(
      qu,
      ~ qgam(
        relative_abundance ~ s(age_kyr, k = 10),
        data = ba_qr_data,
        qu = .x
      )
    )
  )


# -------- Checking the models --------

# Check the output:
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ba_quantile_models))) {
  
  cat(
    "\n\n============================\n",
    "Quantile:", ba_quantile_models$qu[i],
    "\n============================\n"
  )
  
  qgam::check(
    ba_quantile_models$model[[i]],
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.3
  )
}

# Extract diagnostic as a table:
ba_quantile_diagnostics <- ba_quantile_models %>%
  transmute(
    qu,

    convergence = map_chr(
      model,
      ~ {
        value <- .x$outer.info$conv

        if (is.null(value)) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          as.character(value)
        }
      }
    ),

    max_abs_gradient = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ {
        value <- .x$outer.info$grad

        if (is.null(value)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          max(abs(value), na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      }
    ),

    min_hessian_eigenvalue = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ {
        hessian <- .x$outer.info$hess

        if (is.null(hessian)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          min(
            eigen(
              hessian,
              symmetric = TRUE,
              only.values = TRUE
            )$values
          )
        }
      }
    ),

    actual_proportion_below = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ mean(
        .x$y <= fitted(.x),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),

    model_rank = map_int(
      model,
      ~ .x$rank
    ),

    number_coefficients = map_int(
      model,
      ~ length(coef(.x))
    ),

    edf = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ summary(.x)$s.table[1, "edf"]
    )
  )

ba_quantile_diagnostics

# It should be:
  # Convergence = Full convergence;
  # small absolute gradient;
  # a positive minimum Hessian eigenvalue;
  # model_rank == number_coefficients;
  # actual_proportion_below close to the requested qu;
  # edf not very close to the maximum possible value. 


# Refit the models (if needed):
ba_q60_bfgs <- qgam(                         # Quantile 0.60
  relative_abundance ~ s(age_kyr, k = 6),
  data = ba_qr_data,
  qu = 0.60,
  argGam = list(
    method = "REML",
    optimizer = c("outer", "bfgs"),
    control = mgcv::gam.control(maxit = 300)
  )
)

qgam::check(ba_q60_bfgs)   # The model worked

ba_q95_bfgs_k5 <- qgam(                      # Quantile 0.95
  relative_abundance ~ s(age_kyr, k = 5),
  data = ba_qr_data,
  qu = 0.95,
  argGam = list(
    method = "REML",
    optimizer = c("outer", "bfgs"),
    control = mgcv::gam.control(maxit = 300)
  )
)

qgam::check(ba_q95_bfgs_k5)   # The model worked

ba_q99_bfgs_k5 <- qgam(                      # Quantile 0.99
  relative_abundance ~ s(age_kyr, k = 5, bs = "cr"),
  data = ba_qr_data,
  qu = 0.99,
  argGam = list(
    method = "REML",
    optimizer = c("outer", "bfgs"),
    control = mgcv::gam.control(maxit = 300)
  )
)

qgam::check(ba_q99_bfgs_k5)   # The model worked


# -------- Replace the models (if any) --------

ba_quantile_models$model[[which(ba_quantile_models$qu == 0.60)]] <- ba_q60_bfgs
ba_quantile_models$model[[which(ba_quantile_models$qu == 0.95)]] <- ba_q95_bfgs_k5
ba_quantile_models$model[[which(ba_quantile_models$qu == 0.99)]] <- ba_q99_bfgs_k5


# -------- Get parameters from the models --------

# Function to extract statistics from the models and quantiles:
extract_qgam_stats <- function(model) {
  
  sm <- summary(model)
  
  tibble(
    edf = sm$s.table[1, "edf"],
    deviance_explained = 100 * sm$dev.expl
  )
}

# Get the parameters:
ba_quantile_results <- ba_quantile_models %>%
  mutate(
    statistics = map(model, extract_qgam_stats)
  ) %>%
  select(qu, quantile_label, statistics) %>%
  unnest(statistics)

ba_quantile_results

```

# Individual plot

```{r}

# ------ Define the plotmath labels -------

quantile_breaks <- c("0.60", "0.80", "0.95", "0.99")  
quantile_plotmath_labels <- expression(
  tau == 0.60,
  tau == 0.80,
  tau == 0.95,
  tau == 0.99
)

quantile_cols <- c(
  "0.60" = "#E90BF5",
  "0.80" = "#090FDC",
  "0.95" = "#13A408",
  "0.99" = "#b2182b"
)


# ------ Generate predictions -------

age_grid <- tibble(
  age_kyr = seq(
    min(ba_qr_data$age_kyr, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(ba_qr_data$age_kyr, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 400
  )
)

# ------ Plot the quantile trajectories -------

# Logarithmic y-axis:
ba_quantile_predictions <- ba_quantile_models %>%     # For the logarithmic plot
  mutate(
    prediction = map(
      model,
      function(current_model) {

        pred <- predict(
          current_model,
          newdata = age_grid,
          se = TRUE
        )

        age_grid %>%
          mutate(
            fit = as.numeric(pred$fit),
            se = as.numeric(pred$se.fit),
            lower = pmax(0.2, fit - 1.96 * se),   # Avoid 0 for the logarithmic scale
            upper = fit + 1.96 * se
          )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  select(qu, quantile_label, prediction) %>%
  unnest(prediction)


ba_quantile_abundance_log_plot <- ggplot() +

  # Raw taxon-level observations
  geom_point(
    data = ba_qr_data,
    aes(
      x = age_kyr,
      y = relative_abundance
    ),
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 0.5,
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Uncertainty around quantile trajectories
  geom_ribbon(
    data = ba_quantile_predictions,
    aes(
      x = age_kyr,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      fill = quantile_label
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # Quantile trajectories
  geom_line(
    data = ba_quantile_predictions,
    aes(
      x = age_kyr,
      y = fit,
      colour = quantile_label
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = quantile_cols,
    breaks = quantile_breaks,
    labels = quantile_plotmath_labels,
    name = "Conditional quantile",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = quantile_cols,
    breaks = quantile_breaks,
    labels = quantile_plotmath_labels,
    name = "Conditional quantile",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_reverse(
    breaks = 0:7,
    labels = function(x) x * 1000     # Show the age in yr instead of kyr
  ) +

  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(0.2, 55),
    breaks = c(0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Age (cal yr BP)",
    y = "Species relative abundance (%) (log-scale)",
    colour = "Conditional quantile",
    fill = "Conditional quantile",
    title = "Baiau Superior"
    #subtitle = "Smooth conditional quantile trajectories"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

ba_quantile_abundance_log_plot
```

# -------- Baiau Inferior ---------

# Quantile regression calculation

```{r, Define quantiles, fit the models, check the models}

# Raw data frame for Baiau Superior:
bain_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Raw_unified_data_frames/baiau_inferior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# Compute relative abundances & modify the data frame:
bain_relative_abundances <- bain_raw_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    location,
    sample,
    mean.age,
    Species_ID,
    No
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(         # Compute relative abundances within each sample
    location, 
    sample,
    mean.age
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_count = sum(No, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_abundance = 100 * No / total_count
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

# -------- Smooth quantile regression --------

bain_qr_data <- bain_relative_abundances %>%
  mutate(
    age_kyr = mean.age / 1000
  )

# Define quantiles:
bain_quantile_def <- tibble(
  qu = c(0.60, 0.80, 0.95, 0.99),
  quantile_label = factor(
    c("0.60", "0.80", "0.95", "0.99"),
    levels = c("0.60", "0.80", "0.95", "0.99")
  )
)

# Fit one smooth model for each quantile:
bain_quantile_models <- bain_quantile_def %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(
      qu,
      ~ qgam(
        relative_abundance ~ s(age_kyr, k = 10),
        data = bain_qr_data,
        qu = .x
      )
    )
  )


# -------- Checking the models --------

# Check the output:
purrr::walk2(
  bain_quantile_models$model,
  bain_quantile_models$qu,
  function(model, quantile) {

    cat(
      "\n\n============================\n",
      "Quantile:", quantile,
      "\n============================\n"
    )

    qgam::check(
      model,
      pch = 16,
      cex = 0.3
    )
  }
)

# Extract diagnostic as a table:
bain_quantile_diagnostics <- bain_quantile_models %>%
  transmute(
    qu,

    convergence = map_chr(
      model,
      ~ {
        value <- .x$outer.info$conv

        if (is.null(value)) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          as.character(value)
        }
      }
    ),

    max_abs_gradient = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ {
        value <- .x$outer.info$grad

        if (is.null(value)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          max(abs(value), na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      }
    ),

    min_hessian_eigenvalue = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ {
        hessian <- .x$outer.info$hess

        if (is.null(hessian)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          min(
            eigen(
              hessian,
              symmetric = TRUE,
              only.values = TRUE
            )$values
          )
        }
      }
    ),

    actual_proportion_below = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ mean(
        .x$y <= fitted(.x),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),

    model_rank = map_int(
      model,
      ~ .x$rank
    ),

    number_coefficients = map_int(
      model,
      ~ length(coef(.x))
    ),

    edf = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ summary(.x)$s.table[1, "edf"]
    )
  )

bain_quantile_diagnostics

# It should be:
  # Convergence = Full convergence;
  # small absolute gradient;
  # a positive minimum Hessian eigenvalue;
  # model_rank == number_coefficients;
  # actual_proportion_below close to the requested qu;
  # edf not very close to the maximum possible value. 

# No model is refitted!

# -------- Get parameters from the models --------

# Function to extract statistics from the models and quantiles:
extract_qgam_stats <- function(model) {
  
  sm <- summary(model)
  
  tibble(
    edf = sm$s.table[1, "edf"],
    deviance_explained = 100 * sm$dev.expl
  )
}

# Get the parameters:
bain_quantile_results <- bain_quantile_models %>%
  mutate(
    statistics = map(model, extract_qgam_stats)
  ) %>%
  select(qu, quantile_label, statistics) %>%
  unnest(statistics)

bain_quantile_results

```
